about_the_game:
SAMAGO is an endless 2D precision platformer with a 24-hour twist! Every level is available for just 24 hours, giving you a limited time to compete against other players before it resets. Can you push your limits, go the farthest, and claim the top spot on the leaderboards today?

24-Hours Cycle

For 24 hours every player has the same level layout, as you play you can see other players' attempts from all over the world! After 24-Hours a new level is formed and scores are reset.

Compete With Others

Encounter other players on the map as "ghost frogs." But be careful—the ghosts can snatch your coins if you're not quick enough!

Make Your Frog Your Own

Customize your Frog with different types, costumes, and trails that can be seen by other players!

Collect Rewards

Earn daily rewards by ranking among the top five on the leaderboards.

Features

  • New Level And Leaderboard Every Day

  • See Other Player's Attempts As "Ghost Frogs"

  • Decorate Your House

  • Customize Your Frog

  • Endless platformer level

  • Online Leaderboards

...And More!
